rag.text:
Test: TC-6089 — SPM - OKR - Inline editing of Collaborators field
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
This test verifies inline editing of the *Collaboration field* in both *Overview* and *Side Panel*.


* Editing the Collaboration field in *Overview* and *Side Panel*
* Removing selected values
* Data consistency between Overview and Side Panel

Steps:
1. *Prerequisites:* 5x teams are created in OKR module
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName and create Objective and Key-result
   Data: boxName: TC-6089 SPM - OKR - Inline editing of Collaborators field

* objectiveName: Objective 1
* key-resultName: Key-result 1
   Expected: Objective and Key-result are created and visible in OKR overview
3. Hover over the Objective and Key-result Collaboration fields
   Expected: The row is highlighted (grey background) when the user hovers over it
+ button and tooltip "Add Collaborators " is displayed
4. Click on + button next to Objective Collaborators field
   Expected: Dropdown is displayed with lists of teams.
5. Add teamName
   Data: teamName: Team 1, Team 2, Team 3, Team 4, Team 5
   Expected: Collaborators field display 5 team with icons
6. Click on the grey area of the Objective row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Objective. The Objective Collaborators field is consistent with the value in Overview. Field display all list with full teams names and icons
7. Click in Collaborators field in Side panel
   Expected: Dropdown is displayed with lists of teams.
8. Click on clear x button
   Expected: Field is empty - all values disappear from Side panel and Overview
9. Go to Overview and hover over the Key-result Collaborators fields
   Expected: The row is highlighted (grey background) when the user hovers over it
+ button and tooltip "Add Collaborators " is displayed
10. Click add and add teams and users
   Data: * teamName: Team 1, Team 2, Team 3, Team 4, Team 5
* userName: Admin 1, Admin 2
   Expected: Users and teams are added
11. Hover over to Collaborators field
   Expected: Tooltips with userNames and teamsNames are displayed. Admin 1 is displayed as first in field. +2 button is visible
12. Click in +2 button
   Expected: Popup is displayed showing the remaining two teams:
Team 4, Team 5
13. Click on the grey area of the Key-result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key-result. The Key-result Collaborators is consistent with the value in Overview
